dedupe_keys.name: connecticut statewide telecommunications towers and antennas database

description: This dataset is the Connecticut Siting Council's Statewide Telecommunications Coverage Database of telecommunications towers and antennas. Contents: the location, type and height of towers and antennas in the state, which Connecticut General Statutes section 16-50dd requires the Council to maintain and update quarterly; the catalog shows the dataset last updated on 17 July 2026. Producer: the Connecticut Siting Council, published through the state open data portal data.ct.gov. Coverage: the state of Connecticut, United States. Access: CSV, JSON and XML downloads plus column metadata through the portal, with no login. Licence and cost: free; the catalog page read does not state the licence. Caveats: the Council states it makes no representation that all telecommunications sites are included, adds unlisted sites when it learns of them and welcomes corrections, so completeness is not guaranteed. Simulation uses: tower positions and heights support exposure analysis of cell sites to floods, storms and outages and coverage or backhaul modelling at state scale. It is a regional counterpart to national site inventories such as the Australian RFNSA (data-rfnsa-australian-mobile-base-station-sites).
